scenes.title: 이번 편과 다음 편의 범위
lines: The complete polygon chapter is split into two episodes. This one ends after choosing centers and validating boundaries. The following episode continues with triangle partitioning.

scenes.title: 게임이 달라도 기준점과 경계는 구분합니다
lines: A Dorfromantik tile and a Tiny Glade building need placement references. A Serious Sam screen marker helps locate a target, while a Noita terrain boundary separates open space from solid land.

Across these different purposes, one point and a complete outline carry different information. Equal center points do not make two shapes identical. Choose coordinate averaging or equal distances to sides before calculating. These observations do not identify the games’ internal implementation.

scenes.title: 다른 동굴에서도 경계와 빈 공간을 확인합니다
lines: In another Noita interval, the character passes the right ledge. A point may mark the character, but the red terrain outline and the empty gap beside it remain separate information.
A separate shot descends and returns upward. Bridging across the ledge’s notch could incorrectly fill space that was originally open.

scenes.title: 셰이프즈 투를 처음 보는 분께
lines: Shapez2 is a factory game about processing and delivering target shapes. Belts move the shapes. Compare the shape entering a machine with the pieces leaving it.

scenes.title: 잘랐다는 사실보다 남긴 영역을 검사합니다
lines: Shapez2 processing produces target pieces; some operations discard unwanted material. Triangle partitioning instead requires all pieces together to retain the complete original region.
Filling a Tiny Glade doorway or a Noita passage changes space that should remain empty. Apply the same check to Dorfromantik land. The shapes and pieces in this diagram are defined teaching examples.

scenes.title: 통로의 경계에서 경로의 순서로
lines: The next factory shot compares a boundary with a path. A belt is a transport route, not a polygon outline. Both depend on point order, but connectivity alone does not prove that a region is correct.

scenes.title: 타일을 더하거나 되돌리면 경계도 바뀝니다
lines: Dorfromantik joins hexagonal tiles into land. Placing a tile in an empty slot changes the outline. Inspect an individual tile separately from the combined land.
A separate shot undoes a placed tile. The boundary changes again.
